Remove environment, people, other vehicles, road, snow and advertising/plate characters. Keep realistic glass/interior and opaque bodywork. Show the COMPLETE car, all visible tires/mirrors and original roof accessories/antenna tips in a roomy frame with useful transparent space on all sides. True RGBA transparency, no floor/contact shadow, under-car reflection, glow, background fragments, captions, watermark or checkerboard. Do not add a shark fin or antenna type absent from the source. Do not infer engine specification or precise model year.  Keep the vehicle comfortably inside the frame with clearly visible transparent margins above every roof accessory, below every tire and beyond both ends; do not enlarge it up to the edges. This exact WHITE car is RUSSIAN/CIS KIA RIO QB PRE-FACELIFT FIVE-DOOR HATCHBACK (2011–2015 family). Preserve FOUR side doors and original short hatch tail/window outline, source early large black upper grille/bright perimeter with ovalKIA hood badge, actual earlier swept dark headlights/large upright L-shaped/trapezoidal fog corner housings, original black front-fender side ornament, plain SILVER wheel cover pattern/white mirrors/handles, actual slim roof aerial and existing dark SIDE WINDOW RAIN VISORS. FRONT-SIDE camera nose RIGHT. Remove inner windshield reflective SUNSHADE so realistic clean glass/interior is visible, remove paper notices/plate text/dirt/trees and environment reflections; keep side-window deflectors as actual accessories. Do NOT fit2015 horizontal slim foglamp strips, QBsedan trunk, UBglobal or FB/RioX fascia, modern alloy wheels or roof rails. Original gleb/source/CC BY4 credit is preserved in metadata.
